## What Zubair Anwar Builds
Zubair Anwar engineers production-grade enterprise Business Intelligence systems, automated ETL & Medallion Lakehouse pipelines, and interactive WebGL/3D web applications:
- **Microsoft Fabric & OneLake:** Bronze/Silver/Gold Lakehouse architecture, automated data pipelines, Delta Parquet modeling, and AI Copilot integration.
- **Power BI & Enterprise Modeling:** Star Schema dimensional modeling, advanced DAX time-intelligence calculations, Power Query (M) automation, and Static/Dynamic Row-Level Security (RLS).
- **SQL & Python Analytics:** Relational data warehousing (PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL), Pandas, NumPy, and predictive analytics automation.
- **Interactive 3D / WebGL Engineering:** React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, and Three.js / 2D Navier-Stokes fluid WebGL visualization experiences.
